news.intro: Read the latest news directly from the band.

articles.title: Beast debut at The Assembly
articles.summary: Bizcommunity — One of the earliest contemporary notices of BEAST documents the Cape Town debut at The Assembly and introduces the original line-up: Louis Nel and Rian Zietsman of Taxi Violence, Sasha Righini of The Plastics and Lark vocalist Inge Beckmann.
articles.body: One of the earliest contemporary notices of BEAST documents the Cape Town debut at The Assembly and introduces the original line-up: Louis Nel and Rian Zietsman of Taxi Violence, Sasha Righini of The Plastics and Lark vocalist Inge Beckmann. Source: https://www.bizcommunity.com/Article/196/429/74755.html

articles.title: BEAST: A Band Apart
articles.summary: One Small Seed — An early profile of the newly formed Cape Town project, cited in later band histories as one of the first substantial pieces on BEAST and its unconventional two-bass approach.
articles.body: An early profile of the newly formed Cape Town project, cited in later band histories as one of the first substantial pieces on BEAST and its unconventional two-bass approach. Source: https://www.onesmallseed.com/

articles.title: Inge Beckmann describes BEAST as the polar opposite of Lark
articles.summary: Evan Milton — In a feature on Lark, Beckmann discusses her then-new dual-bass project BEAST, describing it as a local super-project with members of Taxi Violence and The Plastics and as the polar opposite of Lark.
articles.body: In a feature on Lark, Beckmann discusses her then-new dual-bass project BEAST, describing it as a local super-project with members of Taxi Violence and The Plastics and as the polar opposite of Lark. Source: https://evanmilton.wordpress.com/2012/07/22/lark-inge-beckmann-and-paul-ressel-are-back/

articles.title: BEAST — Smoke Swig Swear
articles.summary: Gevaaalik — A contemporary review focuses on what made the debut unusual in South African rock: no guitars, two bassists, drums and a powerful vocalist, praising the simplicity and originality of the resulting sound.
articles.body: A contemporary review focuses on what made the debut unusual in South African rock: no guitars, two bassists, drums and a powerful vocalist, praising the simplicity and originality of the resulting sound. Source: https://gevaaalik.com/beast-smoke-swig-swear

articles.title: Beast: no boundaries
articles.summary: Design Indaba — Design Indaba profiles BEAST around its 2013 Music Circuit appearance, highlighting the band's 'no boundaries' ethos and an organic approach designed to leave room for all four musicians to improvise.
articles.body: Design Indaba profiles BEAST around its 2013 Music Circuit appearance, highlighting the band's 'no boundaries' ethos and an organic approach designed to leave room for all four musicians to improvise. Source: https://www.designindaba.com/tags/beast

articles.title: Raucous rock at Aces n Spades
articles.summary: Design Indaba — Design Indaba's report from its Music Circuit describes a packed Aces n Spades and singles BEAST out as the act the crowd had come to see, documenting the band's rapidly growing Cape Town live reputation.
articles.body: Design Indaba's report from its Music Circuit describes a packed Aces n Spades and singles BEAST out as the act the crowd had come to see, documenting the band's rapidly growing Cape Town live reputation. Source: https://www.designindaba.com/articles/design-indaba-news/raucous-rock-aces-n-spades

articles.title: The Jack Daniel's Music Reporter featuring Cape Town band BEAST
articles.summary: 2oceansvibe — A video feature introduces BEAST to a wider audience through the members' established Cape Town bands, emphasizing the two-bass/no-guitar setup and Beckmann's commanding vocals.
articles.body: A video feature introduces BEAST to a wider audience through the members' established Cape Town bands, emphasizing the two-bass/no-guitar setup and Beckmann's commanding vocals. Source: https://www.2oceansvibe.com/2013/03/22/the-jack-daniels-music-reporter-featuring-cape-town-band-beast-video/

articles.title: The BEAST With Two Bassists — Smoke Swig Swear
articles.summary: Kurt Writes Things — A detailed review reconstructs the band's origin: Rian Zietsman and Louis Nel deciding they both wanted to learn bass, bringing in Sasha Righini, and developing the idea into the dark garage-rock experiment that became BEAST.
articles.body: A detailed review reconstructs the band's origin: Rian Zietsman and Louis Nel deciding they both wanted to learn bass, bringing in Sasha Righini, and developing the idea into the dark garage-rock experiment that became BEAST. Source: https://www.kurtwritesthings.com/things/2013/08/the-beast-with-two-bassists-smoke-swig-swear-album-review

articles.title: Premiere: Watch BEAST's video for Smoke Swig Swear
articles.summary: VICE / Noisey — VICE premiered the title-track video internationally, interviewed Inge Beckmann and presented a short documentary about BEAST's rehearsals, recording and album launch. The feature describes the band as a two-bassist, no-guitar quartet mixing rock, punk and grunge.
articles.body: VICE premiered the title-track video internationally, interviewed Inge Beckmann and presented a short documentary about BEAST's rehearsals, recording and album launch. The feature describes the band as a two-bassist, no-guitar quartet mixing rock, punk and grunge. Source: https://www.vice.com/en/article/premiere-watch-beasts-video-for-smoke-swig-swear/

articles.title: Bardo exclusive acoustic launch at the Cape Town Club
articles.summary: Laura McCullagh — A photo report documents BEAST's intimate acoustic Bardo launch for supporters at the Cape Town Club, noting how the restrained arrangement intensified the band's music and Beckmann's performance.
articles.body: A photo report documents BEAST's intimate acoustic Bardo launch for supporters at the Cape Town Club, noting how the restrained arrangement intensified the band's music and Beckmann's performance. Source: https://lauramccullagh.com/blog/2015/02/beast-bardo-exclusive-acoustic-launch-at-the-cape-town-club/

articles.title: BEAST at Park Acoustics, Pretoria
articles.summary: Running Wolf's Rant — Coverage of Park Acoustics in Pretoria praises BEAST's heavy twin-bass attack, Beckmann's piercing vocals and the drummer's performance, providing a useful record of the band's Gauteng live activity.
articles.body: Coverage of Park Acoustics in Pretoria praises BEAST's heavy twin-bass attack, Beckmann's piercing vocals and the drummer's performance, providing a useful record of the band's Gauteng live activity. Source: https://rwrant.co.za/3rd-edition-of-park-acoustics-for-2015/

articles.title: Could this be SA's finest live rock act?
articles.summary: Mail & Guardian — A major national feature examines the making of Bardo, BEAST's experimental origins and its formidable live reputation. It explains how Zietsman and Nel began the project in a shared-house basement and discusses Zietsman's role mixing the second album.
articles.body: A major national feature examines the making of Bardo, BEAST's experimental origins and its formidable live reputation. It explains how Zietsman and Nel began the project in a shared-house basement and discusses Zietsman's role mixing the second album. Source: https://mg.co.za/friday/2015-04-09-could-this-be-sa-s-finest-live-rock-act/
